dedupe_keys.name: china high resolution global and diffuse solar radiation

description: This PANGAEA series supplies estimated surface global and diffuse solar radiation over China and surrounding grid cells. The research team combines MTSAT imagery with China Meteorological Administration ground observations through a deep-learning model. The current collection lists fourteen annual datasets from 2007 through 2020 at 0.05-degree spacing, with hourly estimates and integrated daily and monthly products. The 2020 landing page confirms HDF5 files and links MATLAB mapping code. The series is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The provider added 2019 and 2020 in February 2023, extending the original descriptor's period. These radiation fields can drive photovoltaic-output and renewable-capacity simulations, complementing installation locations in data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that satellite-derived estimates retain model and observation error, particularly when applied at individual facilities. The parent metadata's date widget shows only the added years, while its annual member list establishes the longer coverage. No raster or code package was downloaded.
